text:
Alex: Quick check — I'm about to apply a small TF change that adds a per-AZ NAT gateway failover route + a route table association for the analytics-subnet in us-west-2b. Plan looks fine but wanted a quick eyeball on ordering/lifecycle. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123 :eyes:

Alex: plan snippet:
```
resource "aws_route" "analytics_default_to_nat" {
  route_table_id         = aws_route_table.analytics.id
  destination_cidr_block = "0.0.0.0/0"
  gateway_id             = aws_nat_gateway.analytics[each.key].id
  depends_on             = [aws_nat_gateway.analytics]
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "analytics_subnet_assoc" {
  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.analytics["west-2b"].id
  route_table_id = aws_route_table.analytics.id
}
```

Maya: quick Q — do we need lifecycle ignore_changes on the association? last time an AZ reshuffle in staging caused Terraform to destroy/recreate and briefly cut egress. :grimacing:

Devon: whole change looks fine. Suggest adding a `create_before_destroy` on the nat gateway and use `ignore_changes = ["allocation_id"]` if you're moving EIPs around. Also watch TGW route propagation — make sure there's no overlapping route in the TGW route table.

Karen: tagging infra-oncall — can we schedule apply during the 5pm-7pm window? analytics has low traffic then. @infra-oncall :calendar:

infra-bot: CI plan passed, but tfsec found an issue: "Unencrypted NAT gateway logs" — can you confirm VPC flow logs + KMS are enabled? See ticket #784.

Alex: thanks. I will add lifecycle + create_before_destroy and enable flow logs with the KMS key. small follow-up: do we need to attach SG to the PrivateLink endpoint for the analytics indexing? This change doesn't touch PL but want to avoid surprises.

Maya: PL endpoint SG is managed by `module/privatelink`. It should be fine but double-check ingress rules for the analytics ENIs. If you want I'll run a canary apply in staging later today.

Devon: pinging @Karen for apply approval window. If she signs off I'll queue the apply at 17:15 PT. :thumbsup:

Karen: approved for 17:15 PT. Please include the plan output in the run and DM me if anything unexpected shows up.

Alex: will do. Thanks all. I'll open a quick follow-up PR with the lifecycle/flowlog changes and tag for review.
